body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: d0fe7738139677dd497e5843a3e5365edeb54f68 -->
Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- The change is small and local to `auto_value` in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/layout/form.rs`. It adds no dependency and does not change the model.
- The widget writes only the draft value. The commit still goes through Apply and the command history, so no command is bypassed. The pinning test checks this: Apply writes 0.5, and one undo restores 0 (Auto).
- The hold is a temporary egui value. It is not saved in the project file or the operation parameters. Save, reopen and MCP therefore carry the same numbers as before. A manual value stays a non-zero number.
- `auto_opt` is not affected.

Results merged with main (local, own worktree, clean trial merge, `-j 6`)
- Pinning test `egui_app::tests::auto_input_manual::typing_over_an_auto_off_input_keeps_it_manual`: 1 passed.
- `camcraft-ui` lib suite: 949 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. The failure of `stock_fit_controls_follow_the_selected_shape` that the author saw (#2170) is not present on merged main.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The full quick gate was not run by me. It is not needed: the diff touches only `crates/ui`, and the ui lib suite covers it.

Checks of the risk points
- Leak between inputs: the hold key is made from the row label. I ran a temporary local test (not in the PR). I typed "0" in Helix pitch, then clicked another number field. Helix pitch went back to Auto at once. I found no leak in that case.
- Leak across pages: the hold is cleared on the next frame in which the row is drawn without focus. The one remaining case is that a page change while the field has focus leaves a stale hold. The row would then show manual 0 for one frame. This is cosmetic.
- A value of 0 on focus loss reads as Auto. This is intended and is the old behaviour.
- Save/reopen and MCP: not pinned by a test, but they are not affected, because no new state reaches the document. This does not block the merge.

Requested before merge
- None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. `editing` is true when any widget except the checkbox has focus (form.rs, the `editing` line). It would be more exact to compare with the id of the edit widget. Consider this in a follow-up.
2. `form.rs` is now 401 lines (limit about 400). Not blocking.
3. Only Helix pitch has a test. The other 16 callers share the widget.

PR text: `Fixes #2178` and the `Changelog:` line are present. No process file, snapshot PNG or golden changed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
